steps.text: Hey ❤️ We're at the bar, and I've finally sat down somewhere that isn't an office chair
Already an improvement
There's food too, so it's winning by a lot 😭
Did you finish on time?
Just about, I had to put the lunch container back in my bag very carefully
Still carrying the book too?
Yes, it has experienced a full working day without being opened once
A useful contribution
Emotional support literature 😌
What's the place like?
Nice, not too busy yet
We've got a little table near the side wall
That does look nice
And the chair isn't trying to destroy my back, which I appreciate
Have you ordered?
Not yet, I'm still looking
I'll let you get on with it
Did the cupboard survive you?
It's currently in several piles across the kitchen
So you're at the point where you regret starting 😭
Deeply
Leave me at least one usable mug, okay?
No promises
I'm putting my phone down for a bit, I'll text you when I'm home ❤️
Okay, talk later
At their table, a little later...

steps.title: HAK//LIVE TRANSCRIPTION
messages: A conversation at the bar is detected near {{name:lena}}

messages.speaker: player
messages.text: She said this was a drink after work. I want to believe I can relax about it, but I keep looking at the screen.

steps.text: You look good
You saw me at work an hour ago
You looked good then too
Is that why you kept looking over?
You thought I was checking whether you'd finished the report?
You're supposed to be
The report got finished, didn't it?
No work talk tonight
You brought it up
I can already tell you're going to be exhausting
Is that how you speak to your boss ?
Should I remind you what my boss did to me ?
..what good weather we have today
Yeah I thought so
You've been smiling since you sat down. I'll take my chances
You always this pleased with yourself?
On a good evening
We've barely started
Exactly
Right, before your head gets any bigger, what are you having?
Get the ginger one, it's good here
Do you give instructions everywhere you go?
Only when I know what I'm talking about
So in your opinion, everywhere
You're getting to know me
Unfortunately
I'm having the orange one
Just to disagree with me?
Because I like it. Shocking, I know
Fine, but don't ask for mine when you change your mind
Don't worry, I wouldn't give you the satisfaction
After their drinks arrive...
Okay, the table was a good choice
So was the bar
You can accept one compliment without collecting the rest
Why stop at one?
Do you come here a lot?
Often enough to know which table isn't beside the speaker
Very strategic
I brought a friend here for his birthday last month. He'd invited six people and booked nowhere
That sounds organised
He called it being spontaneous. I called the owner
So your story about saving the evening is actually a story about knowing someone
We ate, didn't we?
I hope he bought your dinner after that
Of course. If I'm organising it and paying for it, we can celebrate my birthday instead
There it is
What?
The part where you make yourself the main event
You're welcome to tell the next story
I don't think I can compete with your heroic table reservation
You can try
All right, yesterday my professor explained the wrong slide for ten minutes
Nobody said anything?
We were all writing it down. I had half a page before someone finally asked
You should have interrupted him
I was busy assuming he knew more than I did
You make that mistake with everyone in charge?
Less and less lately
Good
That wasn't a compliment to you
I didn't take it as one
That makes a change

steps.title: HAK//NOTICE
messages: {{name:lena}} laughs with her manager over their drinks

messages.speaker: player
messages.text: That smile hurts more than I expected. I used to see it and feel like the person she wanted to be with.

steps.text: What are you doing when classes finish?
Sleeping until I don't hate my alarm anymore
After that
I want a day at the beach with a book and no timetable
Not some big organised thing, just enough time that I don't have to keep checking my phone
I know a good stretch away from the main beach
Of course you do
You can keep mocking my recommendations, but you seem to like this one
I do like it here
See, that wasn't difficult
You're going to be unbearable about this all night, aren't you?
Only until you stop acting surprised that I have good taste
I'm not giving you that one
You don't have to
And you? What do you actually do when you're not in that office?
Go out, find somewhere good to eat, drive somewhere when I have a free day
And tell everyone where to sit when you get there?
Someone has to stop them choosing the table by the toilets
You're not even denying it
Why would I?
I can't decide whether that's confidence or a complete lack of shame
Let me know when you've made up your mind
As the musicians set up at the other end of the room...
Are they playing here tonight?
Looks like it
I thought that was just equipment from another night
Your one drink is nearly finished
Are you timing me?
I'm deciding whether to ask for the food menu
There's one right here
You've noticed
I've been carrying leftover pasta around all day. Let me look at something else
Your phone again?
I'm checking the time
Your boyfriend waiting to hear from you?
I said I'd let him know what I was doing
Tell him the food's good
Why?
So he knows why you're staying
I haven't said I'm staying yet
You've been looking at that menu for five minutes
Maybe I'm hungry
Then stay and eat with me
All right, I want to hear a bit of the music too
But I'm choosing the food
I thought you'd say that
Give me a minute, I'm going to let him know
We're going to get something to eat before leaving, there's a band starting here 😊
So you're staying a bit longer?
Yeah, I hadn't realised they had live music tonight
What are you getting?
A flatbread and fries, nothing very sophisticated
Better than carrying your lunch around all evening
That container is empty now, it can stop judging my decisions 😭
I thought you were just going for a drink
I did too, but we're having a nice time and I haven't eaten since lunch
All right
I'll still text you when I'm home ❤️
Okay
When the food arrives...
Dinner, before I eat all the fries 😌
Looks good
It smells good too, I'm going to eat while it's hot
Enjoy your food
Talk in a bit ❤️
Are the fries allowed to be eaten now?
I took one photo, you'll survive
They looked better without the phone between us
You can have my attention without being dramatic about it
Then put it down and try that
The flatbread?
No, the tablecloth
Keep talking and I'll eat your half too
I ordered extra fries for a reason
You do have your uses
Careful, that's nearly another compliment
A few songs into the set...
What did you say?
Move your chair over here, I'm not shouting across the table
You could have just asked me to sit next to you
I just did
In the most bossy way possible
And yet you're moving the chair
Because I can't hear you, don't look so pleased
I'm not stopping you
Let me move my bag before you put your foot through it
Is the book getting its own chair too?
It has better manners than you, it deserves one

steps.title: HAK//NOTICE
messages: {{name:lena}} moves her chair beside her manager to hear him over the music
She leans closer to answer him, her hand resting briefly on his forearm

messages.speaker: player
messages.text: It's the hand on his arm that gets to me. Such a small gesture, and I'm sitting here wondering how much closer they'll get.

steps.text: You know this one?
Yeah, don't ask me to sing it
I wasn't going to risk the evening
Excuse you, I might be very good
You might. I'm enjoying this too much to find out
You're horrible
You laughed
That doesn't make you less horrible
You're different out here
Less tired than I was at six?
You actually hold my gaze when you're talking to me
Maybe you stare too much
I like looking at you
You could try being subtle
I could. I don't see the point
I noticed
After the set, with the plates cleared...
I should check the bus times
I'll get the bill
I can pay for my food
I invited you
That doesn't mean I can't pay
It means I'm paying tonight
You really are like this everywhere
You haven't had a boring evening, have you?
No, I'll give you that
I'll take it
There's a bus in about twenty minutes
Plenty of time. Get your jacket
Please?
Get your jacket, please
See, you can learn
